Label: Pause / sub menu
Notes: In a match this opens the sub menu. Anywhere else it asks whether to quit the game

Label: Confirm / advance
Notes: Advances a line of dialogue, takes the shot, presses the highlighted button

Label: Toggle AUTO
Notes: The game picks your cards and your throw. Your clicks lock while it is on

Label: Show formation
Notes: Holds the formation overlay up while it is held down

Label: Faster
Notes: Steps the match speed up one notch

Label: Slower
Notes: Steps the match speed down one notch

Label: Show the combat log
Notes: Opens and closes the rolling text window in an Adventure fight

Label: Use an item
Notes: Opens the item pouch in an Adventure fight

Label: Flee the run
Notes: Leaves an Adventure run early. You keep part of the haul - see adventure_flee_keep in Tuning.csv

Label: Screenshot
Notes: Writes a PNG beside your save. Handy for a presentation
